items.title: Buckingham interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2019
items.q: the second was always a fella named Jimmy Getzoff. And there Jimmy and Sid’s right in front of me.

ctx.x: And you hope the fire alarm doesn’t go off like it did today.

I’ve had some things happen. I had a roof collapse in a control room one time with — water on the roof came crashing in and I dived under the console. My engineer dived over the tape machine. I’ve never had a fire alarm go off, but I’ll tell you one thing that happened. There was a great arranger in L.A. named Gene Page. And I’m sitting there, I think, usually our sessions would be 10-1, 2-5, 6-9, and if you went late, 10 to 1 in the morning, but then you’re into an hour overtime, after midnight. So you usually…
